propositions: BindingRepository.alert() and other callers build alert records without timestamp_ns field, causing alert_store.is_deduped to default ts to 0 and never suppress duplicates within the 24-hour window
A recurring lifecycle condition (corrupt retired file, repeated binding retirement) appends one duplicate alert record per pass indefinitely instead of deduping within the window
The fix centralizes timestamp_ns stamping in alert_store.append so all callers gain the field automatically, with caller-supplied values preserved to avoid changing existing stampers
Existing disk records lacking timestamp_ns must remain readable without errors by treating missing timestamp_ns as out-of-window (ts=0)
The dedup test must be rewritten to assert one deduped record with timestamp_ns instead of the current status-quo assertion of two records without it
